name: Aman Kumar Panda
summary:
Results-driven banking professional with 4+ years of experience in retail and small-business lending, gold loans, LAP, PL and
micro-enterprise loans. Experienced in managing sales, collections, cross-selling, branch targets, customer relationships
and team performance. Currently working as a Branch Sales professional at HDB Finance Services Ltd. Previously managed a
team of 10 staff as an Area Manager at Bandhan Bank. Proven track record of achieving business targets and receiving multiple
performance awards.
